latent_precision: float16 before float64 nearest-center distances; no quantization of original feature reconstruction residuals
calibration: r*min(1,r/T(content)) before unchanged rendering; ablation replaces T(content) with global normal tail; global affine after baseline rendering
baseline: Unmodified SubspaceAD mechanism, existing official PCA and DINOv2-S, refreshed GPU forward for all four groups; compare every refreshed baseline map against earlier CPU maps with atol1e-4/rtol3e-5, then evaluate baseline on the same fresh maps as calibrated groups
image_score: maximum of actual output map for every variant
normal_partition: reuse previous normal training statistics/threshold split, PCA has seen both; no coverage guarantee
test_notice: Previously accessed benchmarks; settings frozen before this new evaluation; not independent blind validation
prediction_storage: persist compact lossless NPZ with original float32 residual grid plus explicitly quantized float16 context descriptors; regenerate 256 maps per-category for exact evaluation, clear only generated staging maps

acceptance.acceptance_notice: Both dataset macros must satisfy image noninferiority and the same gain branch; category improvement and median consistency apply. These are exploratory engineering gates, not journal acceptance criteria.

normal_only_support: 27/27 categories passed normal-data feasibility gate; not an anomaly detection result
novelty_notice: Prototype conditioning, quantile calibration and bounded suppression are established ideas. Own implementation/experiments do not establish an original publishable algorithm.
pca_orientation: Resolve arbitrary PCA column signs against the frozen content-prototype frame. No change to reconstruction objective, covariance, rank, residual score, image choice or calibration parameters.
integration_notice: Use the previously fitted one-pass Chan PCA models for every baseline/calibration group, with canonical column signs for frozen prototype coordinates. No new PCA fit or hyperparameter selection; actual combined inference is fully evaluated.
